articles.title: Zero Latency VR Launches 'Venue Success' Program with Dedicated Operator Support
articles.summary: Zero Latency VR has created a new global support function called Venue Success, appointing industry veteran Brett Bovio as Senior Venue Success Manager to lead it. The program gives Zero Latency's worldwide network of FEC and LBE operators dedicated, hands-on support beyond the core technology offering. This is a meaningful move for FEC operators running free-roam VR, as stronger operational backing can directly improve uptime, guest throughput, and revenue performance.

articles.title: 2026 Golden Ticket Awards Announce 28 Amusement Industry Winners
articles.summary: Amusement Today's Golden Ticket Awards, among the most prestigious recognition programs in the amusement and attractions industry, named 28 winners at a live ceremony held at the new park COTALand in Austin, Texas. Categories span theme parks, FECs, water parks, and other attractions. FEC operators should review the full winners list to benchmark best-in-class experiences and identify competitive trends.

articles.title: Hololabs Studio Debuts Multi-Room Mixed Reality Attraction Format at IAAPA Expo Europe
articles.summary: Canadian creative tech studio Hololabs Studio is introducing a new LBE attraction format at IAAPA Expo Europe that combines physical themed sets with mixed reality in a ticketed, guided, multi-room walk-through experience. The format is specifically engineered to solve the long-standing FEC challenge of balancing immersion, guest capacity, and physical footprint. For FEC operators exploring next-gen VR or mixed reality attractions, this format could represent a commercially viable alternative to traditional free-roam VR.

articles.title: TicketSpice Details Targeting and Timing Strategies That Drove 18x ROAS for Attraction Operators
articles.summary: Ticketing platform TicketSpice has published actionable insights from attraction marketing campaigns that achieved 18x return on ad spend and six-figure revenue, highlighting patterns around audience targeting, campaign timing, and follow-up sequences. As FEC operators face rising pressure to justify marketing spend, these data-backed strategies across email, SMS, and AI-assisted advertising offer a practical roadmap. The platform is expanding its marketing suite, making it a more integrated option for operators seeking all-in-one ticketing and marketing tools.

articles.title: InPark Magazine Issue 111 Focuses on Frictionless Guest Experiences and Technology
articles.summary: The latest issue of InPark Magazine centers on the theme of frictionless guest experiences, covering ticketing, in-park purchasing, Halloween programming, and how technology can eliminate obstacles between guests and attractions. Features include a look at InfoComm 2026, premium Halloween strategies, and insights from accesso and Jora Vision. FEC operators will find multiple actionable angles on improving guest flow and monetization.

articles.title: Texas' Largest Family Entertainment Center Set to Open in Houston in 2026
articles.summary: A new FEC billing itself as the biggest in Texas is slated to open in Houston in 2026, signaling continued investor confidence in large-format family entertainment destinations. The development reflects a broader national trend toward anchor-sized FECs that combine multiple entertainment verticals under one roof. Operators in the Houston market and beyond should take note of the competitive landscape shift this represents.

articles.title: Six Flags, Plague Productions, and Warner Bros. Invest in Premium Interactive Horror with 'The Conjuring: Beyond Fear'
articles.summary: Six Flags is partnering with Plague Productions and Warner Bros. Discovery Global Experiences to deliver a premium interactive haunted attraction based on The Conjuring franchise, raising the bar for Halloween programming at regional amusement parks. The investment underscores a growing industry trend toward IP-driven, ticketed premium experiences within existing facilities. FEC operators running Halloween events should watch how premium tiered horror offerings perform against standard haunted attractions this season.

articles.title: Chuck E. Cheese Adventure World Makes International Debut in Mexico
articles.summary: Chuck E. Cheese has launched its Adventure World concept internationally for the first time, opening a location in Mexico and signaling the brand's push to expand its refreshed, larger-format FEC model beyond the US. The international debut is a significant indicator of how the repositioned Chuck E. Cheese brand is gaining traction with franchise and development partners globally. FEC operators and investors should monitor this expansion as a benchmark for scaled family entertainment concepts entering new markets.

articles.title: Six Flags Magic Mountain Announces World-First Thrillglider Roller Coaster for 2027
articles.summary: Six Flags Magic Mountain has unveiled Thrill Glider, a first-of-its-kind roller coaster combining flying, motorbike, and suspended coaster technologies into an entirely new category called the Thrillglider, set to debut in 2027. The announcement reinforces Six Flags' continued capital investment in differentiated thrill attractions across its portfolio. While primarily a theme park story, FEC operators with thrill ride components should note the industry's intensifying focus on novel, category-defining attractions to drive visitation.

articles.title: Slick City and Activeon Expand Into Europe with New Parks in Sweden and Austria
articles.summary: Slick City, the indoor slide and active entertainment park brand, is accelerating European expansion through a partnership with Activeon, opening new venues in Sweden and Austria. The move highlights how US-originated indoor active entertainment concepts are increasingly finding traction in international markets. FEC operators and franchisors considering global growth should track this expansion model as a case study in cross-border scaling.

articles.title: Indoor Entertainment Drives Attractions Boom Across the UAE
articles.summary: A new report highlights how indoor entertainment is fueling a significant boom in the UAE attractions market, with demand for climate-controlled family experiences accelerating investment in the region. The trend mirrors similar indoor FEC growth patterns seen in other high-heat markets globally. Operators and suppliers with international ambitions should view the UAE as a high-priority growth market for indoor entertainment concepts.

articles.title: New LaPorte, Indiana FEC to Feature Bowling, Mini-Golf, Arcade, and More
articles.summary: A new multi-attraction indoor FEC is planned for LaPorte, Indiana, combining bowling, mini-golf, arcade, and additional entertainment options under one roof. The project reflects the continued rollout of diversified, anchor-style FECs into mid-sized American markets. For suppliers and developers, this represents another opportunity in the ongoing wave of new FEC construction across secondary markets.

articles.title: Japanese Arcade and Entertainment Brand Selects Haywood Mall for First South Carolina Location
articles.summary: A Japanese arcade and entertainment center concept has chosen Haywood Mall in South Carolina for its first location in the state, continuing the trend of mall-anchored Asian entertainment brands expanding across the US. This is likely a reference to a Round1-style operator, which have proven effective at revitalizing mall traffic and driving repeat visits. FEC operators in mall settings should note the competitive dynamic these experiential anchors create.

articles.title: Robobike Launches Immersive Motorbike Simcade Platform for Competitive Socialising Venues
articles.summary: UK-based Robobike has introduced a commercially available motorbike-themed simcade attraction featuring motion, haptics, wind effects, photorealistic visuals, and multiplayer competition, developed over three years and seven design iterations. The platform is positioned for competitive socialising venues and commercial leisure operators looking for a differentiated, high-engagement attraction. FEC operators seeking new anchor experiences beyond standard arcade games should evaluate this as a potential revenue driver.

articles.title: India's Amusement Industry Posts Summer 2026 Growth but Rising Costs Squeeze Margins
articles.summary: India's amusement and attractions sector recorded attendance growth in summer 2026, but operators are reporting that rising costs are putting significant pressure on profit margins. The dynamic closely mirrors challenges facing FEC operators in Western markets, where post-pandemic demand growth has been offset by labor and supply cost inflation. International operators and investors eyeing India should factor margin compression into their growth projections.

articles.title: Indian Amusement Industry Body Calls for GST Reform to Support Growth
articles.summary: The Indian Association of Amusement Parks and Industries (IAAPI) is formally calling on the government to rationalize GST rates to support growth and reduce cost burdens on amusement operators and consumers. Tax policy is a critical operational issue for FEC operators in India, where high tax rates have historically constrained consumer spending at entertainment venues. This advocacy effort could have significant implications for any operator or investor with India market exposure.

articles.title: Six Flags Earns 25 Top Honors at 2026 Golden Ticket Awards
articles.summary: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation swept the 2026 Golden Ticket Awards, earning 25 top honors across categories covering new attractions, roller coasters, and entertainment programming. The showing reinforces Six Flags' position as a dominant force in North American regional amusement, particularly following its merger with Cedar Fair. FEC operators competing in regional markets should benchmark Six Flags' investment strategy in attractions and guest experience.

articles.title: New Indoor FEC Opens in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee Over Labor Day Weekend
articles.summary: A new indoor family entertainment center has opened in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee, capitalizing on the high-traffic Labor Day holiday weekend for its launch. The opening adds to a growing number of FEC debuts timed to seasonal demand peaks, reflecting operators' awareness of the importance of launch timing for early revenue generation. Local and regional FEC operators should monitor new market entrants in fast-growing suburban Nashville communities.

articles.title: InPark Editorial: Why Removing Friction Is the Most Important Guest Experience Goal
articles.summary: InPark Magazine publisher Martin Palicki argues that making the guest experience as friction-free as possible, from ticketing to in-park purchasing to attraction access, should be the central priority for attraction operators in 2026 and beyond. The editorial frames technology not as a novelty but as a tool to remove obstacles between guests and experiences. FEC operators looking to reduce queue frustration, simplify payments, and improve guest satisfaction will find this a timely and relevant read.

articles.title: NRG Adventure Park Coming to Jacksonville's Southside
articles.summary: NRG Adventure Park has announced plans to open a new location on Jacksonville's Southside, adding another active entertainment venue to the growing Florida market. The expansion signals continued investor appetite for adventure park concepts in suburban markets with strong family demographics. Suppliers and FEC developers should track NRG's rollout as an indicator of where active entertainment investment is heading.

articles.title: First Renderings Revealed for MADCAPS Entertainment Center in Maricopa, Arizona
articles.summary: New renderings offer the first detailed look at MADCAPS, a planned entertainment center in Maricopa, Arizona, giving the local community and industry observers a preview of the venue's design and attraction mix. Maricopa is one of the fastest-growing cities in the US, making it an attractive market for new FEC development. The project is worth watching as an example of purpose-built FECs targeting high-growth suburban communities.

articles.title: Designing for Real Guests: Why LBE Operators Must Move Beyond the 'Average' Visitor
articles.summary: Experience designer and writer argues that location-based entertainment venues are routinely built around a fictional average guest who does not exist, leading to designs that underserve nearly everyone who actually walks through the door. Drawing on research from military and design fields, the piece makes a compelling case for inclusive, human-centered design in FECs and LBE attractions. Operators planning new builds or renovations should use this as a checklist for auditing their design assumptions.

articles.title: Attraktion! Installs Full Product Catalogue at Polish Adventure Park
articles.summary: Attractions supplier Attraktion! has completed an installation of its full product catalogue at a Polish adventure park, showcasing how a single supplier can outfit an entire venue with a cohesive range of attractions. For FEC operators and developers evaluating suppliers, this project demonstrates the feasibility and efficiency of working with a single-source provider for multi-attraction fitouts. The Polish market also reflects growing investment in indoor adventure and FEC-style venues across Central and Eastern Europe.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment to Open at Golden Triangle Mall in Late October
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment is set to open a new location at Golden Triangle Mall in late October 2026, continuing the brand's aggressive mall-based expansion strategy. The timing ahead of the holiday season positions the venue to capture significant family traffic during one of the highest-revenue periods for FECs. Mall-based FEC operators should watch Launch's continued rollout as a benchmark for leasing strategy and seasonal launch timing.

articles.title: New Mini-Golf Attraction Opens in Cardiff City Centre
articles.summary: A brand-new mini-golf attraction has opened in Cardiff city centre, adding to the growing number of experiential leisure venues entering UK urban markets. The opening reflects the continued expansion of competitive socialising and experiential mini-golf concepts in city-centre locations across the UK. Operators and investors in the UK leisure market should note the increasing density of mini-golf competition in major urban centres.

articles.title: Dollywood Claims More Golden Ticket Awards Than Any Other Theme Park in the World
articles.summary: Dollywood in Pigeon Forge, Tennessee, won four additional Golden Ticket Awards at the 2026 ceremony, accumulating more total honors than any other theme park globally. The consistent recognition highlights Dollywood's operational excellence and guest experience standards as a model for regional attractions. FEC and attraction operators can draw lessons from Dollywood's approach to theming, hospitality, and seasonal programming.

articles.title: Massachusetts Amusement Center Adds Four-Story Free-Fall Ride
articles.summary: A Massachusetts amusement center has installed a four-story free-fall ride, significantly upgrading its thrill attraction offering and differentiating itself from competitors in the regional market. Adding a signature high-visibility ride is a proven strategy for driving new trial visits and generating social media buzz for FEC operators. Suppliers of compact thrill rides suitable for FEC footprints should take note of growing demand for this category.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Opens in Pensacola with Massive Multi-Attraction Complex
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment has debuted a large-scale complex in Pensacola, Florida, featuring a diverse mix of attractions designed to appeal to a wide range of age groups and party sizes. The Pensacola opening is part of Launch's broader national expansion and reflects the ongoing market demand for large-format indoor FECs in sunbelt markets. FEC operators and developers tracking competitive openings in the Southeast should review Launch's attraction mix and pricing strategy.
